theme: Cool green escape - while the plains swelter, Kashmir stays green and cool: Gulmarg's hills under a running gondola, Sonamarg's meadows and glaciers, the Dal calm at dawn
season: Peak summer (early July 2026). The Amarnath Yatra is underway, so the valley is busy and fully open. Flights landing in Srinagar, every pass and the Z-Morh tunnel clear, Mughal gardens in full bloom, Chinars in full leaf, Gulmarg green with the gondola running, Sonamarg's high meadows lush under snow-topped peaks, and the Dal glass-still and cool at dawn (Srinagar ~15-30C) while the plains bake.
campaign_name: Kashmir Cool green escape, valley wide open [INR] - 06 Jul 2026
subject: Cool mornings, green meadows, and Kashmir wide open
